def same(a, b):
    return all(a[d] == b[d] for d in range(5))

def dot(a, b):
    return sum(a[d] * b[d] for d in range(5))

def main():
    import sys
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    it = iter(data)
    n = int(next(it))
    if n > 11:
        print(0)
        return
    points = [[0]*5 for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(5):
            points[i][j] = int(next(it))
    
    vectors = [[[0]*5 for _ in range(n)] for _ in range(n)]
    for i in range(n):
        for j in range(n):
            for d in range(5):
                vectors[i][j][d] = points[j][d] - points[i][d]
    
    bad = set()
    
    for i in range(n):
        found_bad = False
        for j in range(n):
            if found_bad:
                break
            for k in range(j+1, n):
                if same(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]):
                    continue
                if dot(vectors[i][j], vectors[i][k]) > 0:
                    bad.add(i+1)
                    found_bad = True
                    break
    
    print(n - len(bad))
    for i in range(1, n+1):
        if i not in bad:
            print(i)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
